info.title: Crawl Price Index API
info.description:
An independent weekly observatory of what the web charges AI to read it. Free endpoints need no key. The full per-domain dataset is gated: subscribe at https://crawlpriceindex.com/#access, or pay per weekly edition in USDC via the x402 offer returned by GET /v1/dataset.

Evidence policy: every signal we publish is labelled observed, derived or inferred. See GET /v1/methodology.

tags.name: dataset
tags.description: Gated by subscription key or a redeemed crawl pass

tags.name: free tier
tags.description: Newsletter, data sample and change alerts

get.description: Returns the per-crawler stance recorded for a domain in the current weekly edition, its Tranco rank, and its percentile against every parsed domain. Pass domain=context to retrieve coverage and freshness without a lookup.
How every signal is obtained and whether it is observed, derived or inferred; what we explicitly do not measure; the corrections policy; and the pinned methodology version.

Every parsed domain's stance for every tracked crawler, plus aggregates, payment signals, country editions and (for subscribers) accumulating weekly history. Responses are watermarked to the requesting customer. Without a key the endpoint returns HTTP 402 with a machine-payable x402 offer.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Subscription key or redeemed crawl pass. May also be sent as Authorization: Bearer.

402.description: Payment required — body carries an x402 offer

get.summary: Redeem an on-chain payment for a crawl pass
get.description: Verifies a USDC transfer on Base against the amount and recipient in the x402 offer, then issues a seven-day snapshot pass. Each transaction can be redeemed once.

post.summary: Join The Weekly Crawl and get a free data sample
Get alerted when a domain's AI-crawler access changes
Re-send a subscriber's API key to the email on file

200.description: Always the same response, whether or not the address is a subscriber

stances.description: Per crawler: b blocked, a allowed, p partial, u unlisted, n no robots.txt. Evidence type: observed.

percentile.description: Share of parsed domains blocking fewer crawlers. Evidence type: derived.

block_rates.description: Per crawler: blocked count and rate_pct. Evidence type: derived.

per_domain.description: One row per parsed domain, with a stance per tracked crawler. Evidence type: observed.

country_editions.description: Evidence type: derived. ccTLD is a proxy for country.

enforcement.description: Declared blocks versus enforced blocks on the publisher panel. Small n — quote with its denominator.

trends.description: Week-over-week movement. Subscriber tier only; withheld from per-crawl passes.

evidence.description: The provenance model for every signal class.

_license.description: Per-customer watermark: issued_to, key_fingerprint, terms, served.
